doc: M3-RND-01: the Reefball water sphere (WaterSphereRig, game/world/water/sphere/water_sphere_rig.gd). docs/kb/tech/water_sphere.md. Colours are palette.json swatches (named in `swatches`), the underwater look's lagoon set (M2-RND-09).

sphere._note: The ball's size and the mesh's tessellation (segments around, rings top to bottom).

optics._note: As underwater.json's: sigma = -ln(transmit) / transmit_distance_m per channel; the in-scatter darkens with depth below the ball's top. The surface refracts the screen by refraction_strength (view-space normal xy, scaled by 1/depth), reflects the sky at roughness, and from inside shows the Snell window (asin(1/ior)) with TIR in tir x tir_gain outside it. The swell displaces the surface swell_m along its normal at swell_scale_m. At night the water column carries the sea-glow (glimmer.gdshaderinc, colour script rule 3) at the zone's hymn_zone_sea_glow, or the rig's own sea_glow_energy, x sea_glow_strength (as underwater.json's), independent of the light level (M3-RND-05).

god_rays._note: An ellipsoid FogVolume filling the ball with underwater_shafts.gdshader (shafts along the sun, fading below the ball's top). Only on tiers with god_rays and volumetric fog on.

caustics._note: M3-RND-04: the caustic web on what's inside the ball (water_sphere_caustics.gdshaderinc), projected along the sun; uniforms of the same name with a caustic_ prefix. It fades with the water above a point along the sun (falloff_m), with view distance and over wall_soft_m inside the wall, and scales with the scene's daylight.

profiles._note: M3-RND-26: per-use rows laid over the sections above key by key (WaterSphereRig.profile). Colours are palette swatches (named in each row's swatches).

tamsule_drop._note: The Tamsule Bell's held drop (tamsule_bell.md §1, the contract: a 14.0 x 11.5 m oblate spheroid centred on SphereAnchor). N-12: perfectly still at rest (no swell, a steady caustic web), pushed cyan (colour script ch07), glowing with the bound light that holds it (glimmer_bound, steady, no sea-glow noise), and throwing its web on the catch-pool, the posts and the bell's underside, allowed to clip to white (the shade disc, §0). under.radius_m bounds the direct web round the axis to the catch-pool and its coping (13.2 m; the big17 gate: it fell on the harbour water by the dock). under.top_m and floor_m are relative to the centre: the drop's equator (the bell's inside above the rim) and under the catch-pool's floor (y -2.5).
tamsule_drop._quality_note: The PC's pass-3 cost row 65: the drop cost 0.36-0.43 ms at High 1440p against the 0.3 ms target, the god-ray FogVolume the bulk; at High the drop keeps its refraction and caustic web and leaves the shafts to Ultra.
